remarks: Welcome to the epitome of luxury living in this gated community! Situated on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this expansive 2-acre level lot offers the perfect canvas for your dream home. Indulge in the finest amenities as you envision your future oasis. Imagine hosting memorable gatherings in your grand estate, complete with spacious living areas, elegant dining spaces, and breathtaking architectural design. Conveniently located right on the New York border, you'll enjoy the best of both worlds. Within a short 15-20 minute drive, you'll find yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Greenwich Avenue, renowned for its upscale shopping, fine dining, and cultural experiences. For avid golfers, the prestigious Stanwich Country Club is a mere 5-minute drive away, offering a world-class golfing experience and a host of recreational amenities. Embrace the opportunity to build your architectural masterpiece in this highly sought-after community. Create a legacy of luxury living and immerse yourself in a refined lifestyle that seamlessly combines privacy, exclusivity, and convenient access to nearby amenities. Don't miss out on this incredible chance to make your dreams a reality. Schedule your private tour today and embark on a journey of limitless possibilities.
